"""Portable comparison of the two head-dynamics certificates and scanner checks."""
import hashlib,json,os,platform,resource,subprocess,tempfile,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(os.environ.get('RULE30_REPLAY_ROOT',Path.cwd())).resolve()
OUT=Path(os.environ.get('RULE30_REPLAY_OUTPUT',ROOT/'results/problem1/20260905_frontier_head_verification.json'))
PATHS=['results/problem1/20260905_frontier_head_primary.json','results/problem1/20260905_frontier_head_independent.json','results/problem1/20260905_periodic_rational_verification.json']
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def canon(x):return json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
def pretty(x):return (json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
def T(v):return v^((v<<1)|(v<<2))
def G(g,v):return T(v) if g=='t' else T(v)^1 if g=='u' else T(v)^1^(2 if v%2==0 else 0)
def A(v):
    bs=[int(c) for c in bin(v)[2:]] if v else []
    out=[(bs[n-2] if n>=2 else 0)^((bs[n-1] if n else 0)|b) for n,b in enumerate(bs)]
    return sum(b<<(len(out)-1-n) for n,b in enumerate(out))
def evaluate(word):
    v=0
    for g in word:v=G(g,v)
    return v
def main():
    start=time.monotonic();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1<<30,1<<30))
    p,i,old=[json.loads((ROOT/s).read_text()) for s in PATHS]
    for r in (p,i,old):
        assert sha(r['source_text'].encode())==r['result_hashes']['source_sha256']
        assert sha(canon(r['result_summary']))==r['result_hashes']['result_sha256']
        compile(r['source_text'],'embedded-source','exec')
    ps=p['result_summary'];s=i['result_summary'];h=ps['head_data'];o=ps['orbit_data']
    assert ps['completed'] and s['completed'] and not ps['validation_failures'] and not s['validation_failures']
    for key,raw in (('head',h),('orbit',o)):
        r=p['original_run_records'][key];c=dict(r);digest=c.pop('payload_sha256_excluding_this_field')
        assert sha(canon(c))==digest
        assert sha(canon(r['result_summary']))==r['result_hashes']['normalized_summary_sha256']
        assert sha(pretty(raw))==r['result_hashes']['raw_data_sha256']
        src=r['executed_source_utf8'];compile(src,'original-'+key,'exec')
        assert sha(src.encode())==r['result_hashes'].get('source_sha256',r['result_hashes'].get('executed_source_sha256'))
    sr=p['original_run_records']['orbit'];hr=p['original_run_records']['head']
    assert sha(pretty(h))==sr['inputs']['operative_existing_cycles']['sha256']
    assert sha(canon(h['cycle_levels']))==sr['inputs']['operative_existing_cycles']['selected_cycle_levels_sha256']
    assert sha((ROOT/PATHS[2]).read_bytes())==hr['inputs']['operative_named_state']['sha256']==sr['inputs']['operative_orbit']['sha256']==i['inputs'][PATHS[2]]
    assert sha(canon(old['result_summary']['full_orbit_hex']))==sr['inputs']['operative_orbit']['selected_array_sha256']
    assert p['additional_sources']['orbit']['source_text']==sr['executed_source_utf8']
    assert sha(sr['executed_source_utf8'].encode())==p['additional_sources']['orbit']['source_sha256']
    assert h['frontiers']==s['frontier_levels']
    assert len(h['cycle_levels'])==len(s['cycle_rows'])==16
    for a,b in zip(h['cycle_levels'],s['cycle_rows']):
        assert a['width']==b['width'] and a['cycles']==b['cycles']
    assert s['first_split'] is None and ps['head_checks']['first_split'] is None
    for r in h['marginals']:
        phase,k,depth=r['phase'],r['k'],r['h']
        vals=sorted({v>>(2*(k-depth)) for v in s['frontier_levels'][phase][str(k)]})
        assert sha(canon(vals))==r['lhs_sha256']==r['rhs_sha256']
        assert r['equal'] and len(vals)==r['lhs_count']==r['rhs_count']
    assert len(h['marginals'])==s['frontier_head_identity_cases']==90
    assert len(h['invariant_checks'])==18 and all(r['A_image_subset'] and not r['escaping_states'] for r in h['invariant_checks'])
    cores=[]
    for r in s['frontier_core_rows']:
        c=h['cores'][r['phase']][str(r['h'])]
        assert c['core']==r['core'] and c['cycle_decomposition']==r['core_cycles']
        assert c['first_stabilization_time']==r['stabilization_age']
        im=set(r['initial_frontier']);counts=[len(im)]
        for removed in c['removed_at_each_image_step']:
            new={A(v) for v in im};assert sorted(im-new)==removed
            im=new;counts.append(len(im))
        assert counts==r['image_counts'] and im==set(c['core'])=={A(v) for v in im}
        assert c['full_width_cycle_comparison']=='equal' and r['equals_full_width_cycles']
        cores.append({'phase':r['phase'],'h':r['h'],'core_size':len(im),'stabilization_age':r['stabilization_age']})
    for a,b in zip(h['named_head_checks'],s['counterexample_prefix_checks']):
        assert (a['h'],a['head'],a['age'],a['in_ordinary_O_p_h'],a['in_exact_age_image'])==(b['h'],b['head'],b['age'],b['ordinary_member'],b['aged_member'])
    assert s['first_aged_rejection_h']==ps['head_checks']['earliest_strict_age_rejection']['h']==3
    for a,b,c in zip(o['identity_checks'],s['covariance_checks'],old['result_summary']['full_orbit_hex']):
        assert a['r']==b['r'] and a['stored_orbit_state_hex']==c
        assert a['equal'] and a['strong_equal']
        assert a['left_hex']==a['right_hex']==b['common_high_part_hex']
        assert a['strong_left_hex']==a['strong_right_hex']==b['full_original_width_high_part_hex']
    assert len(o['identity_checks'])==len(s['covariance_checks'])==234
    certs=s['periodic_point_generator_certificates'];scanner=[];forced=0
    assert {(c['phase'],c['h'],c['value']) for c in certs}=={(r['phase'],r['h'],v) for r in s['frontier_core_rows'] for v in r['core']}
    for c in certs:
        word=c['generator_word'];v=c['value'];phase=c['phase']
        assert len(word)==c['h'] and word[0]==phase and evaluate(word)==v
        residue=3 if phase=='p' else 1;out=phase
        for g in word[1:]:
            residue=G(g,residue)&15
            d=residue&3;out+='t' if d==0 else 'u' if d==1 else 'p'
        assert residue==v&15 and evaluate(out)==A(v)
        q='u' if residue==7 else 't' if residue==11 else None
        row={'phase':phase,'h':c['h'],'value':v,'input_word':word,'A_word':out,'terminal_residue':residue,'forced_append':q}
        if q:
            f=evaluate(out+q);assert f==4*A(A(v))+3
            row['forced_value']=f;forced+=1
        scanner.append(row)
    summary={'completed':True,'validation_failures':[],'all_frontier_sets_agree':True,'frontier_levels_compared':18,'cycle_widths_compared':16,'all_cycle_lists_agree':True,'marginals_verified':90,'invariance_rows_verified':18,'cores_compared':cores,'named_head_rows_compared':8,'first_aged_rejection_h':3,'first_ordinary_rejection_h':s['first_ordinary_rejection_h'],'strong_covariance_cases_agree':234,'weaker_covariance_cases_agree':234,'periodic_point_word_certificates_verified':len(certs),'scanner_word_checks':scanner,'valid_forced_scanner_appends':forced,'single_cycle_finite_scope':'Exactly one cycle at each width1..16; no assertion at other widths.'}
    source=Path(__file__).read_text()
    result={'experiment_id':'problem1-frontier-head-age-verification-20260905','timestamp_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'git_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'question':'problem1','hypothesis':'Both independent constructions agree on all recorded head/cycle/core data and the existing orbit; the same 45 periodic-point histories satisfy the exact scanner update.','backend':'Portable read-only certificate comparison plus high-to-low A and generator-history replay','parameters':{'input_paths':PATHS,'local_cpus':1,'memory_bytes':1<<30,'new_frontier_or_orbit_inputs':0,'scanner_inputs':'Only the 45 already-recorded periodic-point histories'},'inputs':{s:sha((ROOT/s).read_bytes()) for s in PATHS},'hardware':{'machine':platform.machine(),'processor':platform.processor(),'cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},'software':{'python':platform.python_version(),'platform':platform.platform()},'runtime_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'source_text':source,'result_summary':summary,'result_hashes':{'source_sha256':sha(source.encode()),'result_sha256':sha(canon(summary))},'status':'finite-exhaustive','proof_scope':'The explicitly listed finite records and histories; all-depth claims use the separate proofs.','interpretation':'The exact core theorem does not depend on a universal unique-cycle conjecture. The scanner retains an unbounded word. B_all remains open.','limitations':['No new occurrence or forced-schedule census.','No all-width uniqueness claim from finite passage.','Documentation hashes in original runs are run-time snapshots, not current-byte equality assertions.']}
    fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=OUT.parent,prefix=OUT.name+'.',suffix='.tmp')
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:
        json.dump(result,f,sort_keys=True,indent=2);f.write('\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp,OUT)
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k!='scanner_word_checks'},sort_keys=True))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
